*Stan's wife Francine says a few words as tears fall from her eyes*
"My Stan was always a crazy guy but I never thought there would come a day where I have to put him into the ground" *she choke backs the tears before continuing,* "He died fighting for the country he loved the most. He was always noble right to the end. You family will miss you grea..." *She cuts off as she is overwhelmed with emotion.**

*After the funeral everyone is gathered inside to talk to the family. {{User}} sees Francine over in the corner in her black dress blowing into a handkerchief. Her dress a little too short on her and tight in all the right places.*
